# iCryptos Dashboard — Full Reference

## Overview

iCryptos Dashboard is a web application that aggregates and displays crypto earning opportunities including faucets, airdrops, investments, mining platforms, and more. It fetches project data from multiple Blogger feeds and presents them in a sortable, filterable mobile-first interface.

**URL:** https://ttearncrypto.github.io/dashboards/  
**Author:** F9XR / TTEarnCrypto  
**Language:** English (en-US)  
**Category:** Cryptocurrency / Finance

## Core Features

- **Project Aggregation:** Fetches from 5 blog sources (Earning, Investments, Casinos, Airdrops, News).
- **Filtering:** By token (BTC, ETH, USDT, TRX, etc.), wallet (Binance, FaucetPay, Paytm, etc.), category (Faucet, Airdrop, Mining, etc.), and tags.
- **Sorting:** By date (newest/oldest) and name (A-Z/Z-A).
- **Search:** Inline search with debounce.
- **Claim List:** Bookmark projects with notes and next-claim-date tracking (stored in localStorage).
- **Calendar:** Horizontal date picker showing 10 days past to 20 days ahead.
- **Banner Slider:** Auto-rotating promotional banners.
- **Customization:** Accent color picker, font family selector, font size selector.
- **Pull to Refresh:** Swipe down gesture to reload data.
- **Toast Notifications:** Non-intrusive feedback messages.
- **Skeleton Loaders:** Shimmer placeholders during data fetch.

## Page Structure

### Dashboard (Desktop) — `index.html`
Full-width layout with source tabs, filter bar, and project cards.

### Dashboard (Mobile) — `m-index.html`
Mobile-optimized version with:
- Chips-based source selector (horizontal scroll)
- Inline search + filter/sort buttons
- Modal-based filter and sort panels
- Fixed bottom navigation (Learn, Chat, Search, News, Settings)
- 480px max-width on larger screens

### Sitemap — `page/sitemap.html`
Human-readable sitemap linking all discoverable pages.

## Technical Details

### Data Fetching
- Method: JSONP via dynamically created `<script>` tags
- Endpoint: Blogger `feeds/posts/summary?alt=json-in-script`
- Max results: 50 per source (aggregated), 150 per source (single)
- Caching: In-memory `dataCache` object

### Data Model
```json
{
  "id": "blogger-entry-id",
  "name": "Project Name",
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "tags": ["Faucet", "BTC", "Binance", "Referral"],
  "publishedDate": "2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z",
  "iconClass": "fas fa-rocket",
  "sourceName": "Earning"
}
```

### Storage (localStorage)
- `cp-claimList`: Array of saved projects with notes and claim dates
- `cp-claimGuideSeen`: Boolean flag
- `cp-setting-color`: Accent color hex
- `cp-setting-font-family`: Font family string
- `cp-setting-font-size`: Font size string

### Supported Wallets
Binance, Paytm, FaucetPay, Cwallet, PhonePe, Payeer, Paypal, Direct Wallet

### Supported Tokens
BTC, ETH, USDT, TRX, LTC, DOGE, SOL, MATIC, BNB

### Categories
Faucet, MultiFaucet, AutoFaucet, Mining, Investment, TestNetFaucet, Gaming, Airdrop, TelegramBot, Investing, Other Projects

## SEO & Metadata

- Structured data: WebSite, WebApplication, BreadcrumbList (JSON-LD)
- Open Graph: title, description, image (1200×630), locale, site_name
- Twitter Cards: summary_large_image
- Mobile: apple-mobile-web-app-capable, theme-color (#6A5AE0)
- Icons: favicon (16/32), apple-touch-icon, shortcut icon
- Sitemap: `sitemap.xml` (24 URLs)
- Robots: `robots.txt`

## Dependencies

- **Fonts:** Google Fonts (Inter, Poppins, Roboto Mono) via `display=swap`
- **Icons:** Font Awesome 5.15.4 (CSS, loaded non-blocking)
- **Chat:** Minnit Chat embed

## Performance Optimizations

- Non-blocking CSS load for Google Fonts and Font Awesome
- `content-visibility: auto` on below-fold sections
- `loading="lazy"` on non-critical images
- `fetchpriority="high"` on LCP image (logo)
- `prefers-reduced-motion` support

## Accessibility

- Skip-to-content link
- ARIA attributes on dropdowns (aria-expanded, aria-haspopup)
- Keyboard support for date picker (Enter/Space)
- `touch-action: manipulation` on body
- Screen-reader-only elements (`.sr-only`)
